title: test_buildme_rides_the_outline_check hands its patched store to the CodeMother it launches
intention: test_1 of test_buildme_rides_the_outline_check hands the ticket store and chart berths it patches (ticket_file._TICKETS, inspector._CHART_BERTHS) to a CodeMother it launches, so the entry lanes' judges read its fixture.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on akienyoga9i with 03daad62ef1b's unseen_patches: 1 finding, line 87, _TICKETS via transitions.inspect_entry; before the change test_1 was red on yoga over the bus ("inspect 'buildme_rides_the_chart' refused: no answer from codemother"). traces_to: RULE 1 and Law 8: a proof measures its own component, and a judge that reads a store the proof never wrote is a hollow green.
